title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Freelancer. Tip #1
body: Ask what he does and watch it take four attempts. There is no clean Urdu word for it so he says "online kaam karta hoon" and a relative immediately assumes it isn't real. Fiverr means he started there. Upwork means he got serious. Direct clients means he won. It's a sealed deal if a chacha has offered to find him a real job in the last twelve months.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 the dollar rate is a personality trait.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Freelancer. Tip #2
body: Ask how he gets paid, because that's the whole drama. Payoneer, Wise, a card that stopped working in March, or a friend's account in another country. Every Pakistani freelancer has had one payment stuck somewhere for three weeks. It's a sealed deal if he can explain the fee structure of three platforms from memory and gets angry halfway through.
caption:
Tip #2 😭 the dollar rate is a personality trait.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Freelancer. Tip #3
body: Watch the hours. The clients are American so the calls are at 11pm, and he has been living on New York time inside a Pakistani household for two years. His family eats at eight. He works at midnight. Nobody has adjusted. It's a sealed deal if his mother has walked in during a client call and appeared on camera.
caption:
Tip #3 😭 the dollar rate is a personality trait.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Freelancer. Tip #4
body: Ask about the dollar rate and watch the mood shift. He knows today's number. He knows last month's. A good rate week is a genuinely good week and a bad one is felt in the house. It's a sealed deal if he has ever delayed a withdrawal for three days over two rupees and told everyone about it afterwards.
caption:
Tip #4 😭 the dollar rate is a personality trait.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Freelancer. Tip #5
body: Ask about the first big client, because losing one is what turns an amateur professional. Now he takes fifty percent upfront and says so in the first message, and he learned that expensively. It's a sealed deal if he can name the exact month the money stopped and what he did that week.
caption:
Tip #5 😭 the dollar rate is a personality trait.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Freelancer. Tip #6
body: Watch what he tells people at weddings. There is a short version for relatives, a real version for friends, and a third for anyone who might become a client. All three are true. The relative version contains the word "computer." It's a sealed deal if an uncle has described him to guests as "abhi kuch kar raha hai."
caption:
Tip #6 😭 the dollar rate is a personality trait.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Freelancer. Tip #7
body: Ask about the internet. He has two connections and a mobile hotspot as a third, because one client call dropping is a month's reputation. He knows which hours the line degrades. It's a sealed deal if he has ever finished a call standing on a balcony holding a phone above his head.
